syllabus_topics: Interdisciplinary experience between science and Christian faith
Typology of dialogue and confrontation modes between sciences and theologies
Limits, scope, and philosophical and theological foundations of the relationship between science and faith
Historical perspective of science and Christian faith relationship
Contemporary issues in science and Christian faith
assessment_rules: The exam is a two-hour written exam session with two open-ended questions. A limited list of questions is provided to the students. One question is asked by Professor D. Lambert and the other by Professor Bourgine, based on their respective presentations.
